dfn!fnctbco ON Fnctbco.bc_codigo = Fncblanc.cl_ctbco INNER JOIN dst!stpess ON Fncbhist.ci_pess = Stpess.pe_codigo INNER JOIN dfn!fnpagam ON Fnpagam.tg_codigo = Fncbhist.ci_pagam LEFT OUTER JOIN
